title: Jewish Museum Milwaukee

services.name: Be A Docent
services.desc: Jewish Museum Milwaukee provides customized tours for your students to explore history, art and events that still reverberate today. Walking through the Museum, students see topics like the Holocaust, immigration, and community action come alive. We welcome school groups of up to 80 students from Milwaukee and across the Midwest. A trained docent will help your classroom navigate our exhibits; tours may also be complemented with workshops and exceptional guest speakers. The Museum’s content is directed toward students in grade four and higher across nearly any discipline. services.name: Admission
services.desc: Take a self-guided virtual tour of our permanent exhibit with Google View. The permanent exhibit explores the breadth of Jewish life and culture, both within the state of Wisconsin and beyond. Engaging displays and interactive features teach the viewer about immigration, earning a living, intolerance and the Holocaust, Israel, and so much more. Explore our collections through an interactive display of artifacts, recordings, and documents that tell the stories of 10 cherished members of the Milwaukee Jewish community. This immersive experience generates insight about the themes of our permanent exhibit while inspiring continued inquiry. Renowned Wisconsin potter Abe Cohn taught, encouraged
